Rental terms are fixed at creation. Both parties can confirm a full refund, owners can claim after the rental ends, renters can dispute within the window, and anyone can trigger settlement after eligible deadlines. No published network deployment is established. Creator-reported engine and simulation parity tests were not rerun.
